all_quotes.loc: 5.3.3. Analysis of the molecular gas disc
all_quotes.quote: We note that the CO brightness line decreases around the line centre, primarily along the minor axis of the discs, possibly due to an oversubtraction of continuum. This limits our ability to search for misalignments between the inner and outer disc.

The visibility fitting suggests a smaller feature at about 6 au in Sz 65, for which there is no counterpart in either of the profiles extracted from the image plane. We therefore remain cautious about this potential gap.
We measured a continuum R 90 =27 au, and therefore, this should perhaps be expected as the scale height, H, at the very edge of the dust disc is likely ≤ 2.7 au.
The Sz 66 field is visibly noisier because it is found towards the edge of the primary beam in the observations that were centred on Sz 65.

all_quotes.loc: 5.3.3. Analysis of the molecular gas disc
all_quotes.quote: It is difficult to discern true physical effects due to the low signal of the detection in Sz 66, and so we refrain from placing any further constraints on the structure from a kinematic analysis.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA# 2017.1.00569.S, 2018.1.00271.S, 2018.1.01458.S, 2019.1.01135.S, 2015.1.00222.S.
